title: Delegation scope belongs to a human-editable grant template, not a flags list
summary: Charter external_operations grants are chosen at onboarding via a generated delegation-input.json (repo-prefilled, mode: grant, renew_existing) and edited later in Concierge OnboardingAuthorityPanel — both feed the same preview→request→approve→apply facade; nothing writes the charter directly.
